# Anatomical region API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

The shared atlas of brain regions that procedures and recordings point to.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/anatomicalregion/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/taxonomies/anatomicalregion/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `anatomical_region` (detail, create, update), `anatomical_regions` (list)
- **Permissions:** see the [permissions page](/datamodel/permissions/)
- **Uniqueness:** `reference`, `region_id` unique together
- **Uniqueness:** `reference`, `acronym`, `name` unique together

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `name` | string **[required]**; max 200 characters |
| `description` | string; max 2000 characters; nullable |
| `acronym` | string **[required]**; max 15 characters |
| `atlas` | string |
| `reference` | [`anatomicalreference`](/api/taxonomies/anatomicalreference/) id **[required]** |
| `region_id` | number; nullable |
| `parent_acronym` | string; max 15 characters |
| `graph_order` | number; nullable |
| `is_obsolete` | boolean. Retired by the source atlas or ontology; kept for historical records. |
| `replaced_by` | [`anatomicalregion`](/api/taxonomies/anatomicalregion/) id; nullable. Successor term named by the source ontology, when one exists. |
| `ontology_url` | string **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/anatomicalregion/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('anatomicalregion', load_all=True)
records = resp['anatomical_regions']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('anatomicalregion', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.anatomical_regions;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "anatomical_regions": [
        {
            "id": "<id>",
            "name": "Anatomical region 1",
            "description": "",
            "acronym": "",
            "atlas": "",
            "reference": "<anatomicalreference-id>",
            "region_id": 1,
            "parent_acronym": "",
            "graph_order": 1,
            "is_obsolete": true,
            "replaced_by": "<anatomicalregion-id>",
            "ontology_url": ""
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/anatomicalregion/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('anatomicalregion', data={"name": "Anatomical region 1", "acronym": "<acronym>", "reference": "<anatomicalreference-id>"})
record = resp.json()['anatomical_region']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('name', 'Anatomical region 1', 'acronym', '<acronym>', 'reference', '<anatomicalreference-id>'), 'anatomicalregion');
record = created.anatomical_region;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/anatomicalregion/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('anatomicalregion', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['anatomical_region']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('anatomicalregion', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.anatomical_region;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "anatomical_region": {
        "id": "<id>",
        "name": "Anatomical region 1",
        "description": "",
        "acronym": "",
        "atlas": "",
        "reference": "<anatomicalreference-id>",
        "region_id": 1,
        "parent_acronym": "",
        "graph_order": 1,
        "is_obsolete": true,
        "replaced_by": "<anatomicalregion-id>",
        "ontology_url": ""
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/anatomicalregion/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('anatomicalregion', id='<id>', data={"name": "Anatomical region 1 (renamed)"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'name', 'Anatomical region 1 (renamed)'), 'anatomicalregion', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/taxonomies/anatomicalregion/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('anatomicalregion', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'anatomicalregion');
```

## Custom actions

| Action | Request |
|:-------|:--------|
| `descendants` | GET `/api/private/taxonomies/anatomicalregion/<id>/descendants/` |

`descendants` returns the regions below a region in its atlas hierarchy.

## Data model

The fields are described for the web forms on the [Anatomical region data model page](/datamodel/taxonomies/anatomicalregion/).
